benchmark_comparison: Five complete general VLM benchmark comparisons against original Qwen3.5-2B and the bilingual V2 predecessor. Values are percentages. TextVQA uses VQA soft accuracy; MTVQA-KO uses strict exact match. Deltas are percentage points against Qwen, with the V2-to-final MTVQA regression explicitly disclosed. Observed English retention is not a statistical equivalence claim.
korean_ocr_comparison: Korean scene-text recognition on the 20,086 released public K-STR-Bench crops. Official word accuracy and jaso1-NED retain upstream rules. Auxiliary CER with spaces and WER use the 19,855 references without wildcard characters. Word-accuracy CI is a 10,000-resample paired scene-cluster percentile bootstrap over 6,193 scenes; it does not measure training-seed variance.
training_dynamics: Exact durable V3 SFT/GRPO training and checkpoint-development histories. Training curves use the same weighted 10-update windows as W&B, with no further smoothing. Stars mark selected SFT update 1800 and GRPO update 600; all executed milestones remain visible. English dashed lines are source-wise V2 baseline minus 2 percentage points. The SFT update 600 TextVQA candidate fails this guard. GRPO starts from selected SFT and shows no additional OCR development utility gain.
training_recipe: V3 is a continuation of the bilingual V2 foundation. Dataset volumes describe full pools, whereas selected exposure is 28,800 SFT rows and 2,400 GRPO prompts, at 0.863 and 0.895 pool passes, respectively. Both stage budgets completed one full pool pass. Synthetic OCR includes Korean and English; real OCR is Korean. General QA replay is used to retain bilingual capability. Final weights merge selected SFT and GRPO adapters into a single BF16 model.
